# NEMO Facsimile Regulations
## General Faxing NEMO is no light feat. Facsimile's should be limited to important issues and not just a simple hellp to the Marshal's Office. When faxing NEMO, the following information must be included in the message: - The reason for the fax, including a detailed description of the issue and any relevant information - The specific NEMO team being requested, if applicable - Any relevant evidence or documentation supporting the request - The contact information of the person making the request, including their name, rank, and faction affiliation
## Required Facsimile's NEMO must receive a Facsimile for - All arrests, detentions, and enforcement actions. - Any and all criminal appeals (that the convicted requested to be sent to NEMO). - All investigations into unlawful command decisions, corruption, and injustice. - Any situation where NEMO is requested to deploy a team or intervene in a matter of military justice. - Any situation where NEMO is requested to review or overturn a ruling by local Military Police or Commanding Officers. - Any situation where NEMO is requested to conduct a covert surveillance, intelligence gathering, infiltration, or evidence collection operation. - Any situation where NEMO is requested to deploy during a riot, mutiny, or internal security incident. - Any situation where NEMO is requested to provide aerospace transportation, extraction, prisoner transfer, or rapid deployment capabilities for NEMO operations across the frontier.
